=segments.text: The chapter excerpt introduces six individual Aeon Keepers, their collective entity, and two crucial sentient groups involved in the world's genesis.
Here is a list of named characters and their introductions from the sources:

The six Aeon Keepers are the central characters, existing in the Ethereal Realm as "willing guardians of the cosmic infrastructure". They maintain their eternal vigil and operate as collective consciousnesses who communicate through harmonic frequencies.

| Character Name | Introduction / Specialization | Source(s) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Lyaris** | The first of the Keepers to notice the shift in the planetary stabilization. Her consciousness is defined as "distributed awareness across probability matrices", and she monitors the *vrill* currents. She is the one who ultimately decides the intentions given to the Neferati. | |
| **Theron** | Specializes in **temporal mechanics**. He confirms the stability of the forming planet (Earth) by analyzing settling tectonic plates, magnetic field strength, and atmospheric composition. He calculated the optimal timing for the Neferati manifestation. | |
| **Vaelith** | Described as the **most pragmatic** of the assembly. She projects her awareness through the Veil (the friction-space between realms) to analyze physical reality. She reported the physical conditions of the forming world (water coverage, continents, volcanic activity) and identified the transformed Pelagor. | |
| **Mordain** | Maintains the **deepest connection to the library's temporal archives**. He noted the passage of 3,417 years since the catastrophic shattering of Tiamat and articulated the need for "ground-level maintenance". He issued the final command to release the Neferati. | |
| **Syreth** | The **youngest** of the Keepers, though 'young' is relative. Her thoughts carry wistfulness regarding the loss of physical form, and she urged her companions to manifest the Neferati. | |
| **Korath** | His consciousness is described as **steady and immovable**. He believes they serve better without the constraints of physical form. He designed the fundamental parameters for Neferati physiology and abilities but cautioned against the risk inherent in granting them autonomy. | |

| Named Entity | Introduction / Description | Source(s) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Aeon Keepers (Collective)** | Six consciousnesses maintaining an eternal vigil in the Ethereal Realm, responsible for preserving the *vrill* infrastructure and preventing reality from collapsing into chaos. They exist within the **Akashic Records** (a great library). | |
| **Neferati** | Beings created by the Aeon Keepers to serve as living extensions of their consciousness and intermediaries between ethereal and physical reality. They were saved during the shattering of Tiamat. One thousand Neferati are being manifested to establish presence on the new world, guide the transformed Pelagor, and teach geomantic harmony. | |
| **Pelagor (Original Race)** | The only other sentient life that shared the Aeon Keepers' previous world, Tiamat. They were sleek, aquatic beings (octopi) whose boldest members had ventured onto land. | |
| **Transformed Pelagor (New Race)** | The descendants of the original Pelagor who survived the impact by retreating into deep thermal caves. They are now massive forms (twenty to forty feet tall) composed of **living stone and crystallized minerals**. They retained core abilities like geomantic awareness and consciousness-touch but "lack the knowledge" or framework to use them properly, relying only on instinct. | |
| **Marduk** | The entity or planetary body whose collision shattered Tiamat, initiating the catastrophe that forced the Aeon Keepers into the Ethereal Realm. | |
